newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Graft, inefficiency cost Ecuador millions - auditor.
newsitem.headline: Graft, inefficiency cost Ecuador millions - auditor.

text.p: Ecuador lost $55 million from corruption and inefficiency in the customs service during the six months of the government of former President Abdala Bucaram, a congressman said Tuesday.
"The irregularities in the customs service cost the state 213,231 sucres ($55 million)," Congressman Luis Chiriboga said, quoting a report by an official auditing subcommittee.
"Abdala Bucaram is one of the people responsible for this as he named the customs authorities," Chiriboga said.

Earlier this month, the Supreme Court ordered Bucaram's arrest for suspected misuse of presidential funds. Bucaram, who lives in exile in Panama, was deposed by Congress in February on grounds of "mental deficiency".
